items.name: Granny's Apple Fries
items.description: Warm crispy apple bites with cinnamon sugar and vanilla cream dip — the chain's signature snack.
items.verdict: The one food item at the park worth planning around. Hot, shareable, and gone in ninety seconds.

items.name: Carved meat plate
items.description: Carved meats with sides from the market cafeteria — the parents' real-meal anchor.
items.verdict: Honest cafeteria food that beats the alternatives. Eat at 11:30 and ride through the noon wave.

items.name: Kids' build-a-meal
items.description: The configurable kids' meal with allergy-safe substitutions — main, sides and drink chosen by the child.
items.verdict: The picky-eater solution, with the allergy handling that justifies Legoland's food reputation.
